description: This script configures and manages diagnostic LEDs on an OpenWrt device during various system states, such as pre-initialization, failsafe, and upgrade. It reads configuration data from JSON files and system config, and controls system LEDs accordingly.

methods.name: preinit_match_diag_led
methods.description: Detects and sets the diagnostic LED during the pre-initialization phase based on board configuration JSON files.

methods.name: match_diag_led
methods.description: Matches and sets the diagnostic LED based on current system configuration.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Determines the current status LED configuration from system or board info.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED blinking behavior based on the given system state argument.
